chapters.title: Chapter 4378 Oh, Shit IV
paragraphs: At such words, Noah's eyes flashed with interest rather than disapproval.
Someone who refused limitation.
Who broke rules specifically because they were rules. Who achieved power through sheer stubborn insistence that arbitrary caps didn't apply to her.
He understood that impulse very well.
Riya looked toward Kael with theatrical offense.
"Unc, are you really talking bad about me in front of The Glorious Ancestor?" Her tone dripped with mock hurt.
"Why not mention how I'm the fucking strongest? Most attuned to the Way? How I've mastered techniques even you struggle with? Hmph."
She turned her gaze back to Noah, her jewel-blue eyes tracking across the molten crimson-blue landscape surrounding them.

"Ancestor," she said, her tone shifting to something more genuine, "I've wanted to leave that little bubble for thousands of years. But Uncle Kael here kept insisting we had to wait for your call. So I waited, even though it was boring as hell."
She looked around with obvious fascination.

"What is out here? I've only heard stories of the First Folds, legends passed down from the Original Seed Members about external existence. I'm curious to explore everything. To see what's beyond that isolated pocket we've been trapped in."
"Oh, Early Creatures. Where are they at? I feel like stepping on a few right now..."
Her gaze drifted past Noah, toward the distant outline of The
Infiniverse floating in the region of Collapse.
"What is that over there?" she asked, genuine interest in her voice. "That structure with the massive presence? It feels... important. Powerful."
Noah looked at her, this rebellious prodigy who'd exceeded all expectations, who carried more raw power than most ancient beings.
"Explorations will come later," he said calmly. "For now, let us return to your home. Let us see how far you all have come in these years."

Kael rose immediately, his form blazing with excitement. After all those subjective years of isolation, the Ancestor was finally coming to witness what they'd built, to see the Civilization they'd forged in his absence.
Riya sighed, looking around wistfully at the molten landscape, at the distant Infiniverse, at the vast expanse of external existence she'd been denied for so long.

"Can't I just look around for a bit?" she asked, though her tone suggested she already knew the answer. "Just a quick exploration, see what's out here, maybe punch something to test the local power levels..."
"Later," Noah said, his voice carrying magnetism that transcended simple command. "Let's go."
His words pulled at something fundamental in both of them...the architectural connection between Ancestor and Civilization, between
origin point and those who followed his Way.
Even Riya, for all her rebellious nature, felt the pull of that
connection.
She waved her hands in frustration, muttering something that sounded suspiciously like "fucking tyrannical authority" under her
breath.
Blue mana erupted around all three of them, not Noah's signature, but the combined power of Kael and Riya, their authority wrapping around the space they occupied and preparing for transit.
The surrounding existence rippled.

And they disappeared, leaving behind only the molten crimson-blue landscape and the persistent glow of Noah's territorial expansion still painting vast swathes of existence in his Civilization's authority.
Bound for a pocket dimension that had been isolated for millions of subjective years.
Bound for a Civilization that had apparently exceeded every projection Noah had made about what isolated development could
achieve.
Bound for answers to questions he hadn't even known he should be asking.
The Early Creature, Osmont, was about to witness what his seeds had grown into when left to develop in fertile soil for long enough.
And based on what he'd already seen, on Kael's fifty Quintillion, on Riya's sixty-one, on the territorial expansion and system integration and sheer weight of advancement he'd received that was still
continuing...
It was going to be glorious.
Magisterial!
Seconds passed...or perhaps no time at all, temporal mechanics
becoming uncertain when beings of this complexity manipulated
space, and then they manifested.
HUUM!
Noah's perception expanded to drink in their new surroundings, and what he witnessed made even his tyrannical composure pause.
They floated in a region of multicolored light.
Waves of color that had no names, hues that existed between the standard spectrum, all of it flowing like currents in an ocean made of
pure radiance.
And over all of it, submerging everything in its influence, a brilliant blue light pulsed.
His blue. His signature. The mana he'd given them when establishing
this isolated pocket eons of subjective years ago, now refined and amplified until it had become the foundational element of an entire
realm.
Noah looked ahead- far ahead, his perception stretching across distances, and there...
A massive circular domain floated in the sea of multicolored light.
It looked as large as a world. Perhaps larger.
The structure blazed with concentrated authority.
But appearances were deceptive.
Noah's enhanced perception could sense the truth...inside that
circular domain, space had been folded, compressed, expanded through techniques.
The interior dimensions stretched for Gigaparsecs, an entire Fold contained within boundaries that looked planetary from the outside.
Kael floated forward, his blue-winged form radiating pride and
anticipation.
"I welcome the Ancestor," he said, "to observe the changes of what has happened to your Civilization after all these years."

His gesture toward the massive structure carried the weight of someone presenting their life's work...not just his own efforts, but the accumulated achievement of every being who'd developed within this isolated pocket.
As they moved closer to the circular domain, preparing to enter, Noah
felt presence manifest behind him.
Close. Very close.
He turned slightly, and there was Riya, floating mere inches from his
back, her jewel-blue eyes half-closed and her expression...
She was sniffing him.
Actually leaning in and inhaling deeply, her face showing an
expression of appreciation if it weren't so brazenly disrespectful. "Ancestor," she said, her tone filled with genuine curiosity mixed with
her irreverence, "what did you do to your mana to have it smell so good? It's like... fuck, I don't even know how to describe it. It's interesting."

chapters.title: Chapter 4379 Oh, Shit V
paragraphs: Kael appeared beside her in a blur of movement, his hand swatting toward her with force that would have obliterated Folds.
Riya dodged easily, flowing backward with grace that suggested she'd been evading Kael's disciplinary attempts for thousands of years.
"Riya!" Kael's voice thundered with stern disapproval. "If you cannot be respectful, keep your distance from the Ancestor! Your behavior is unacceptable for-"
"Ancestor this, Ancestor that, loosen up." Riya muttered under her breath, rolling her eyes.
But soon after, her expression brightened, mischief dancing across her features. She floated upward, positioning herself in front of both Noah and Kael with a flourish.

"O Great Ancestor," she said, her tone dripping with sarcasm as she rolled her eyes, "it would be our dearest honor to present to you your grand Civilization. The Emergence Protocols have been initiated, and the Citizens of Mana cannot wait to bask in your glorious, magisterial unfiltered presence."
She bowed with exaggerated grace.
At her words, something shifted in the massive circular structure ahead.
A small doorway of pure mana formed.
Blue light poured from the opening, coalescing into a beam that reached across the distance separating them from the domain.
The beam touched them, and Noah felt pull.
Not physical force....it was existential gravity, the architecture of the Civilization recognizing its Architect and drawing him home!
The multicolored light around them blurred, compressed, became a tunnel of radiance that carried them forward.
A moment of brilliant transfer, existence folding around them...
Noah opened his eyes.
And witnessed glory.
The skies stretched above him, filled with radiant blue clouds that pulsed with accumulated mana.

These were concentrations of pure power that had achieved sufficient density to take on cloud-like forms, floating masses of authority that painted the heavens in shades of transcendent azure. Below...
Vast and endlessly glorious radiant white-blue structures spread across the landscape like a Civilization that had been designed by beings who understood architecture at the conceptual level.
This wasn't construction. This was manifestation...buildings and towers and grand structures that existed because the Civilization had collectively decided they should exist, form following function
following pure aesthetic perfection.
Floating in the air for thousands of miles, massive circular ringed
white buildings stayed aloft through mana alone.
Each structure was painted with intricate Glyphs...thousands of them, millions, each one a compressed theorem of power woven into the very fabric of the buildings themselves!
The circular structures featured round rotating centers, massive orbs of authority that spun with precision, generating power through their
motion.
Between the floating rings, tall tower-like skyscrapers rose from the ground below, their surfaces pulsing with mana-filled brilliance.
And in the skies of this entire place, floating at various altitudes across the vast expanse...
A few million beings hovered, all of them looking upward.
Looking at him.
Noah's perception swept across them, and what he sensed made his tyrannical heart pulse with glory!

These weren't weak beings gathered out of curiosity. Every single one radiated shocking levels of mana, their bodies pulsing with authority that would have made them powers in their own right anywhere in external existence.
They all gazed toward him with expressions of awe, reverence, and recognition. The architectural connection between Ancestor and those who followed his Way, made manifest in their collective
acknowledgment.
And the moment he arrived, the moment his presence registered fully
within the boundaries of this isolated domain...
JISOLATED CIVILIZATION - FULL SCOPE ASCERTAINMENT
COMPLETE
Complete architectural analysis of Civilization of Mana achieved
Actual Full Population Assessment: 6,783,294 total beings
Average Complexity: 8.47 Quintillion
Average Purity: 8.47 Quintillion
Development Level: EXCEEDS ALL PROJECTED PARAMETERS
As Architect and Origin Point of this Way of Existence, additional
boons are being granted:|
+5 Quintillion Complexity
+5 Quintillion Purity
Calculating additional advancement based on Civilization's refined
techniques and principles...
|+6 Quintillion Complexity
+6 Quintillion Purity]
TOTAL ADVANCEMENT: +11 Quintillion from current baseline
NEW TOTAL: 33.44 Quintillion Complexity
NEW TOTAL: 33.44 Quintillion Purity
BOOM!
Noah felt his power explode upward.
It was not the gradual accumulation of harvest. It was not the methodical advancement through training.

His complexity skyrocketed from 22 to 33 Quintillion in an instant, and the Mana that flooded through his existence threatened to spill out, to cascade from every pore and paint the surrounding reality in
his authority.
He contained it through sheer will, but it was a near thing.

Kael floated ahead, his blue-winged form blazing with pride and joy. His voice boomed outward, projected authority carrying his words across the entire expanse of this isolated realm so every being could
hear.
"Hear me, Citizens of Mana!"
His declaration made the sky itself tremble.

"After eons of isolated development, after generations born and raised within the boundaries of this realm, after perfecting our techniques and refining our understanding of the Way we were give...He has
returned!"
Kael's form blazed brighter.
"I present to you the Architect of Mana himself! The Origin Point of

our existence, the one who gave us infinite power and the principles we have spent millions years elaborating upon! The Ancestor who established this Civilization and then granted us the honor of independent development!"
His voice carried reverence that made the surrounding mana resonate
in sympathy.

"He is The Early Creature, Osmont! The Tyrannical Architect who defies every limitation existence tries to impose! And he stands before us now, not as distant Leader, but as the head of our Civilization, come to witness what we have become in his absence!"
HUUM!
Kael spread his arms wide, his gesture encompassing all the floating
beings, all the grand structures, the entirety of what they had built.

"Welcome home, Ancestor. Welcome to your Civilization of Mana, refined through time and desperation into something worthy of your vision. We are yours to command. Our power is yours to direct. Our existence is yours to guide as you see fit."
He bowed deeply, his form radiating absolute loyalty.
"And now, if it pleases you... perhaps you would address your people?
They have waited so long to hear your voice."
Silence pressed in. Millions of beings floating in the sky, all attention

sentences.text: Kael appeared beside her in a blur of movement, his hand swatting toward her with force that would have obliterated Folds.
Riya dodged easily, flowing backward with grace that suggested she'd been evading Kael's disciplinary attempts for thousands of years.
"Riya!" Kael's voice thundered with stern disapproval.
"If you cannot be respectful, keep your distance from the Ancestor!
Your behavior is unacceptable for-"
"Ancestor this, Ancestor that, loosen up." Riya muttered under her breath, rolling her eyes.
But soon after, her expression brightened, mischief dancing across her features.
She floated upward, positioning herself in front of both Noah and Kael with a flourish.
"O Great Ancestor," she said, her tone dripping with sarcasm as she rolled her eyes, "it would be our dearest honor to present to you your grand Civilization.
The Emergence Protocols have been initiated, and the Citizens of Mana cannot wait to bask in your glorious, magisterial unfiltered presence."
She bowed with exaggerated grace.
At her words, something shifted in the massive circular structure ahead.
A small doorway of pure mana formed.
Blue light poured from the opening, coalescing into a beam that reached across the distance separating them from the domain.
The beam touched them, and Noah felt pull.
Not physical force....it was existential gravity, the architecture of the Civilization recognizing its Architect and drawing him home!
The multicolored light around them blurred, compressed, became a tunnel of radiance that carried them forward.
A moment of brilliant transfer, existence folding around them...
Noah opened his eyes.
And witnessed glory.
The skies stretched above him, filled with radiant blue clouds that pulsed with accumulated mana.
These were concentrations of pure power that had achieved sufficient density to take on cloud-like forms, floating masses of authority that painted the heavens in shades of transcendent azure.
Below...
Vast and endlessly glorious radiant white-blue structures spread across the landscape like a Civilization that had been designed by beings who understood architecture at the conceptual level.
This wasn't construction.
This was manifestation...buildings and towers and grand structures that existed because the Civilization had collectively decided they should exist, form following function
following pure aesthetic perfection.
Floating in the air for thousands of miles, massive circular ringed
white buildings stayed aloft through mana alone.
Each structure was painted with intricate Glyphs...thousands of them, millions, each one a compressed theorem of power woven into the very fabric of the buildings themselves!
The circular structures featured round rotating centers, massive orbs of authority that spun with precision, generating power through their
motion.
Between the floating rings, tall tower-like skyscrapers rose from the ground below, their surfaces pulsing with mana-filled brilliance.
And in the skies of this entire place, floating at various altitudes across the vast expanse...
A few million beings hovered, all of them looking upward.
Looking at him.
Noah's perception swept across them, and what he sensed made his tyrannical heart pulse with glory!
These weren't weak beings gathered out of curiosity.
Every single one radiated shocking levels of mana, their bodies pulsing with authority that would have made them powers in their own right anywhere in external existence.
They all gazed toward him with expressions of awe, reverence, and recognition.
The architectural connection between Ancestor and those who followed his Way, made manifest in their collective
acknowledgment.
And the moment he arrived, the moment his presence registered fully
within the boundaries of this isolated domain...

Noah felt his power explode upward.
It was not the gradual accumulation of harvest.
It was not the methodical advancement through training.

His complexity skyrocketed from 22 to 33 Quintillion in an instant, and the Mana that flooded through his existence threatened to spill out, to cascade from every pore and paint the surrounding reality in
his authority.
He contained it through sheer will, but it was a near thing.
Kael floated ahead, his blue-winged form blazing with pride and joy.
His voice boomed outward, projected authority carrying his words across the entire expanse of this isolated realm so every being could
hear.
"Hear me, Citizens of Mana!"
His declaration made the sky itself tremble.

"After eons of isolated development, after generations born and raised within the boundaries of this realm, after perfecting our techniques and refining our understanding of the Way we were give...He has
returned!"
Kael's form blazed brighter.
"I present to you the Architect of Mana himself!
The Origin Point of
our existence, the one who gave us infinite power and the principles we have spent millions years elaborating upon!
The Ancestor who established this Civilization and then granted us the honor of independent development!"
His voice carried reverence that made the surrounding mana resonate
in sympathy.
"He is The Early Creature, Osmont!
The Tyrannical Architect who defies every limitation existence tries to impose!
And he stands before us now, not as distant Leader, but as the head of our Civilization, come to witness what we have become in his absence!"
HUUM!
Kael spread his arms wide, his gesture encompassing all the floating
beings, all the grand structures, the entirety of what they had built.
"Welcome home, Ancestor.
Welcome to your Civilization of Mana, refined through time and desperation into something worthy of your vision.
We are yours to command.
Our power is yours to direct.
Our existence is yours to guide as you see fit."
He bowed deeply, his form radiating absolute loyalty.
"And now, if it pleases you... perhaps you would address your people?
They have waited so long to hear your voice."
Silence pressed in.
